messages.subject: Timezone and POSIXct handling in RpostgreSQL
messages.subject_clean: Timezone and POSIXct handling in RpostgreSQL
messages.body_plain:
Hi all, 

I'm appending a link to a StackOverflow question I posted a few months 
back. I've still not managed to resolve this one and am hoping that someone 
in this group might be able to help.

https://stackoverflow.com/questions/47832874/timezone-and-posixct-handling-in-rpostgresql

I'm UK based, so the exact example may only be reproducible in the UK. 
However, I'm assuming that the issue is a more general one.

Any pointers or advice greatly appreciated!

Thanks, 

Sam
